subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a portable batch-selection block to the shared message-presentation contract, and which channels must implement its initial supported matrix?
rationale: The choice establishes a public plugin API, normalized callback semantics, fallback behavior, and cross-channel capability guarantees that cannot be selected safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Add a portable batch-select primitive
options.body: Introduce one additive shared block and normalized values-array callback, initially shipping only channel adapters and fallbacks that can satisfy the documented contract.

options.title: Keep selection channel-specific
options.body: Expose native multi-select only through owner-plugin APIs, accepting that workflows will need provider-specific payloads and behavior.

options.title: Defer structured collection
options.body: Leave the scalar presentation surface unchanged until a broader forms or dialog product direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add a portable batch-select primitive
recommendation.body: Introduce one additive shared block and normalized values-array callback, initially shipping only channel adapters and fallbacks that can satisfy the documented contract.
